reviews.text: Don’t fall for it. I generally pride myself on not falling for Instagram ads, but the intrigue of seeing what my kids could look like as they grow was just too enticing. A little spendy- I had expected a week free trial but they had a week option for $9.99. So I thought, why not? I’ll do a bunch of my kids and friends and make them little gifts. Well the product was terrible. Even something as simple as eye color was wrong (my daughter’s light blue eyes are a dark brown in the video). Basically the algorithm just overlayed stereotypical aging wrinkles, greying hair, and sagging skin to a perpetually youthful looking face. The result was frightening! Still, I thought, at least I can just try again-wrong. What they don’t say up front is you $9.99 is not actually a week subscription. It’s a CREDIT subscription. And even if you knew that, they arbitrary credit amount is hidden. So my one garbage video, took 2600 of my 3000 credits. I.e. I paid $9.99 for a creepy stock photo video to haunt my dreams at night. Please don’t fall for this false advertising.
